verdict.rationale: Superpowers is operated through ordinary conversation with the host coding agent. Skills auto-trigger from the user's intent with no special syntax (gh-11, docs-9, docs-16), the agent asks clarifying questions and offers choices in natural language (gh-1, docs-12, docs-46), and direct user requests take precedence over skills (docs-32). Optional slash commands such as /brainstorming complement this (docs-18), and a community user independently praises the conversational brainstorming flow (comm-1). Missing for 10: hands-on evidence that intent-based auto-triggering is reliable (the docs only say it "should" default into planning), and independent corroboration beyond one community comment.
